title: GitHub Pages Workflow
text:
# GitHub Pages Workflow

**What it is:** how tools get published from an iPad using only the GitHub website.

## Steps
1. Create the repo on [[GitHub]] (public if you want free Pages).
2. Upload files by dragging folders from the Files app in Split View.
3. Settings, Pages: set the source to the main branch /docs folder, or to GitHub Actions when a workflow builds the site.
4. A GitHub Action rebuilds data on every push or on a schedule.

## Gotchas learned
- "Add file" creates paths relative to the folder you are currently in, so open the repo root first.
- iOS hides dot-folders such as .github, so create workflow files with Add file, Create new file and type the path.
- Editing an existing file in the web editor can fail in this browser; deleting it and recreating it with Create new file works reliably.
- Private repos cannot use Pages on the free plan; keep sensitive data in private repos and open the file locally instead.
- A workflow pushed before Pages is switched on fails once; re-run it.

## Used by
[[Seizure Watch]], [[CITES Timber ID]], [[Precursor Chemical ID]], [[LE OSINT Framework]], [[Brain Graph]].

title: Lessons Learned
text:
# Lessons Learned

Working rules that came out of the projects.

- **Fewest steps first.** Default to the simplest option and offer depth as an upgrade ([[CEN Seizure Analysis]]).
- **Think iPad.** Anything that needs a terminal should have a web or app alternative ([[GitHub Pages Workflow]]).
- **Public repos are public.** Anything in a public repo, including this vault, can be read by anyone. Keep operational detail, case figures and private repo contents out of it ([[Brain Graph]]).
- **Explain the score.** Show why something is rated High ([[Risk Scoring]]).
- **Test where it runs.** Excel behaves differently from LibreOffice; code that cannot be executed in Claude's environment must be flagged as untested.
- **Reuse one look.** New tools copy the style of the previous ones ([[PCCP House Style]]).

title: PCCP House Style
text:
# PCCP House Style

**What it is:** the shared look for decks, dashboards and bulletins, so everything reads as one family.

## The rules
- PCCP (AIRCOP / Container Control Programme) logo banner across the top.
- Verdana throughout, white background, blue and white accents on dashboards.
- Decks: first slide is a minimal base (full-width logo banner, page number only, no title). Title and content start on slide 2.
- Key facts as short on-slide bullets; the full explanation goes in the speaker notes; relevant photos on slides.
- Template decks: Empty_powerpoint.pptx, PCCP_Insider_Threat_-_ISPS_perspective.pptx and Port_Security_Icebreaker.pptx. The style is also packaged as the skill bundle pccp-house-style-deck.zip.

## Used in
[[Controlled Deliveries Course]], [[Cultural Heritage Course]], [[Seizure Watch]] (bulletins), [[Precursor Chemical ID]], [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]], [[CEN Monthly Bulletin]].

title: Risk Scoring
text:
# Risk Scoring

**What it is:** the common way the projects turn many signals into a High / Medium / Low rating.

## The method
- Several yes/no flags (concealment method, multi-country route, controlled delivery, unusual quantity and similar) each carry a weight.
- Weights add up to a score; thresholds turn the score into a band.
- Weights and thresholds are plain editable numbers, never hidden in formulas.

## Two versions
- [[CEN Seizure Analysis]] scores individual cases and feeds the [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]].
- [[Seizure Watch]] scores news reports on five capped dimensions; seizure weight is limited to 10 points so size alone never decides, and the dashboard explains the scoring in a "How risk is scored" box.

## Principle
Explain every score on screen so an officer can see why something is rated High.

title: Controlled Deliveries Course
text:
# Controlled Deliveries Course

**What it is:** a five-day UNODC-WCO Container Control Programme (PCCP) training course with four timed sessions per day.

## Agenda
1. Foundations and legal framework
2. Planning, coordination and cooperation
3. Operational techniques
4. Special considerations and legal process
5. Practical application and evaluation

## How it is built
- Every session is its own comprehensive PowerPoint, sized to fill its time slot, with the full explanation in the speaker notes.
- Built on the house template ([[PCCP House Style]]).

## Decisions
- One standalone deck per session rather than one big deck, so sessions can be reused.

## Open items
- None recorded.

Sister course: [[Cultural Heritage Course]]. Hub: [[Training Courses]].

title: Cultural Heritage Course
text:
# Cultural Heritage Course

- Then all 20 sessions as standalone decks, using the Port Security Icebreaker deck as the style template ([[PCCP House Style]]).

## Decisions
- Same structure as [[Controlled Deliveries Course]] so both courses can be run and updated the same way.

title: UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data

title: WCO CEN nCEN Data
text:
# WCO CEN nCEN Data

**What it is:** seizure case exports from the WCO Customs Enforcement Network.

## How it is handled
- Analysed in [[CEN Seizure Analysis]] and scored with [[Risk Scoring]].
- Stored only in a private [[GitHub]] repo; no case data belongs in this vault.
- Summarised monthly in the [[CEN Monthly Bulletin]].
- [[Seizure Watch]] compares its open-source findings against it.

title: Brain Graph
text:
# Brain Graph

**What it is:** this project, an interactive graph of markdown notes that runs on iPad. Live at https://glretief-ux.github.io/brain-graph/ (repo glretief-ux/brain-graph on [[GitHub]]). Built with [[Claude Code]]. Entry point: [[Start Here]].

## How it works
- Notes live in the vault/ folder; each double-bracket link becomes a line in the graph and the folder sets the type and colour.
- A GitHub Action rebuilds the graph on every push ([[GitHub Pages Workflow]]).
- "Ask the brain" chat sends your question plus the most relevant notes to Claude through a small Cloudflare Worker that holds the API key.

## Decisions
- Runs entirely in Safari so it works on iPad.
- The repo is public, so notes here must not contain sensitive operational detail ([[Lessons Learned]]).

## Open items
- Create the Cloudflare Worker, add the API key and connect the chat.
- Keep adding notes as projects change ([[Open Items]]).

title: CEN Monthly Bulletin
text:
# CEN Monthly Bulletin

- Output is saved in the bulletins/ folder of the private CEN data repo on [[GitHub]].
- Data comes from [[WCO CEN nCEN Data]] through [[CEN Seizure Analysis]]; branding follows [[PCCP House Style]].

title: CEN Seizure Analysis
text:
# CEN Seizure Analysis

**What it is:** analysis of WCO CEN/nCEN seizure exports to find risk patterns and anomalies, delivered as Excel dashboards and PowerPoint briefs. Source: [[WCO CEN nCEN Data]].

## How it works
- Case-level data becomes weighted yes/no risk flags, then a score, then a High / Medium / Low band ([[Risk Scoring]]). Weights are editable cells.
- A typical workbook has a dashboard (filters, KPIs, charts), free-text search, a risk register, anomaly notes, master data, raw detail lines and a separate tab for personal data.
- Country and corridor studies come as dashboards or slide briefs with the reasoning in the speaker notes.
- Quarterly refresh in [[Power BI]] (free tier) using a single Power Query paste.
- Exports are kept in a private [[GitHub]] repo for version history.
- A live dashboard ([[CEN Seizure Risk Board]]) and a monthly bulletin ([[CEN Monthly Bulletin]]) grew out of it.

## Decisions
- Fewest steps by default: the many-query Power BI build was too complicated, so it became one query. Offer depth only as an upgrade.
- Personal data stays on its own tab.
- Excel traps to remember: test in real Excel, not only LibreOffice (dropdown years are numbers in Excel and text elsewhere; literal dropdown lists are capped at 255 characters).
- M and DAX code cannot be run in Claude's environment, so say that plainly when handing it over.

## Open items (check status)
- Native pivot tables and an interactive route map were interrupted mid-build.
- A multi-country slide brief was in progress.

Hub: [[Law Enforcement Tools]]. Also covers [[UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data]].

title: CEN Seizure Risk Board

# CEN Seizure Risk Board

**What it is:** a live dashboard (a claude.ai artifact) built from [[CEN Seizure Analysis]].

- Power BI-style look with the PCCP logo on top ([[PCCP House Style]]) and a drug-level slicer.
- Cases are scored with [[Risk Scoring]].

## Decisions
- Chosen over a public Pages site because the underlying data is sensitive and the repo stays private.

## Open items
- None recorded.

title: CITES Timber ID
text:
# CITES Timber ID

**What it is:** a public [[GitHub]] repo (glretief-ux/CITES-Timber-ID) that helps officers identify CITES-protected wood by genus, species and subspecies, with 10x end-grain (cross-section) photos.

## How it works
- A searchable species lookup page: type a scientific name and see everything known about it ([[GitHub Pages Workflow]]).
- Styled like [[Seizure Watch]] on purpose.
- Goal: upload a 10x photo and have AI identify the wood, in the spirit of XyloTron.
- Specimens are photographed with the [[Dino-Lite Microscope]].

## Decisions
- Scope narrowed to CITES-protected wood from Africa for now.
- Start with a labelled demo model while looking for open-source sample images for the real one.
- Own confirmed specimens are the ground truth.

## Open items
- Photograph more confirmed African specimens.
- Find open-source sample images and train the real model.

Related: timber news category in [[Seizure Watch]]. Hub: [[Law Enforcement Tools]].

title: LE OSINT Framework
text:
# LE OSINT Framework

**What it is:** a law-enforcement version of OSINT Framework: a tree of categories linking to search sources, for officers to use. Repo glretief-ux/LE-OSINT-Framework on [[GitHub]].

## How it works
- Free sources only, no paid sites.
- Spider-web style look, similar to OSINT Framework but not the same.
- Runs from a laptop and is shared with colleagues by email.
- Includes a searchable world ports and port-code list by country, and a searchable HS (harmonised) customs code tab.

## Decisions
- Free-only rule keeps it usable by any agency.

## Open items
- None recorded.

Sits with [[Seizure Watch]] and [[Precursor Chemical ID]] in [[Law Enforcement Tools]].

title: Precursor Chemical ID
text:
# Precursor Chemical ID

**What it is:** a public repo and site (glretief-ux/Precursor-Chemical-ID) for officers covering drug precursors and other chemicals used in illicit manufacture, including all INCB chemicals. Created 17 Oct 2026.

## How it works
- Identify a chemical by CAS number or UN number and see what it can be used for.
- Search whether a chemical is produced by the company named on the sticker.
- Explains how chemicals are controlled from manufacture to importer, which permits are needed and how to check them.
- Published with the [[GitHub Pages Workflow]].

## Decisions
- Professional look: PCCP logo at the top, Verdana, white background with blue ([[PCCP House Style]]).
- Layout follows [[Seizure Watch]] so the dashboards feel like one family.

## Open items
- (suggested) Fill and verify the chemical data against INCB lists.

Related: hazardous chemical news category in [[Seizure Watch]]. Hub: [[Law Enforcement Tools]].

title: Seizure Watch
text:
# Seizure Watch

**What it is:** a daily open-source news monitor for illegal drug seizures, with risk analysis to support officers. Live at https://glretief-ux.github.io/Seizure-watch-/ (repo glretief-ux/Seizure-watch-, public).

## How it works
- A daily [[GitHub]] Actions run searches the web, extracts the details and publishes the dashboard through the [[GitHub Pages Workflow]] (main branch, /docs folder).
- Searches run in several languages (Arabic, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Hindi; Vietnamese for ivory) and reports are translated into English automatically.
- Extraction picks up ports, airports, vessels, shipping lines and cover cargo.
- Categories: drugs, CITES timber, elephant ivory, protected fauna, hazardous chemicals (the last two feed [[CITES Timber ID]] and [[Precursor Chemical ID]]).
- Dashboard features: month / all-time dropdown on the Seizure Events card, a "How risk is scored" box, and a view counter ([[GoatCounter]]).

## Reports
- Daily 10am one-page bulletin of the top 10 articles, with seizure photos only where available.
- Monday 10am one-page A4 weekly report on smuggling routes (map of origin and destination plus a bar chart). Both use the PCCP banner ([[PCCP House Style]]).

## Decisions
- Risk score uses five capped dimensions and seizure weight is limited to 10 points, so size alone never decides ([[Risk Scoring]]).
- Repo made public because Pages needs it.
- Its look is the model for the other dashboards.

## Requested improvements (check status before relying on them)
- Watchlists and alerts as the first risk-profiling upgrade.
- Coverage map showing language blind spots.
- Weekly one-page bulletin emailed with new corridors and unusual events.
- Test the risk score against seizure case data ([[CEN Seizure Analysis]]).

Hub: [[Law Enforcement Tools]].

title: Stock Simulation
text:
# Stock Simulation

**What it is:** a paper-money portfolio of EUR 1,000, invested by Claude, started 8 October 2026. No real money is involved.

## How it works

- Interested in trading through Liquid (liquid.trade) with the [[Liquid Co-Invest]] connector.

## Decisions

title: Whisky Dashboard

**What it is:** a YouTube analytics dashboard for [[Whisky Lovers Society]], adapted from the open-source Youtube-Dashboard repo by shriyaMadan. Private [[GitHub]] repo (glretief-ux/whisky-dashboard).

title: Whisky Lovers Society
text:
# Whisky Lovers Society

**What it is:** a whisky-review YouTube channel, https://youtube.com/@whiskyloverssociety, started in 2021. A "1000 videos" celebration video tasted 10 whiskies as a thank-you (Oct 2026).

## How it works
- Edited in [[DaVinci Resolve]] (paid version, version 21) on an iPad.
- On the Windows PC the plan is Claude Code with a free Resolve MCP bridge so Claude can edit there ([[Claude Code]]).
- Standing look for videos: colour graded, colourful motion graphics with [[Remotion]], something happening on screen at least every 10 seconds, b-roll and photos.
- Every video also gets SEO titles, description and tags.

## Decisions
- Free MCP add-on route chosen over a paid one.

## Open items
- Set up the Resolve bridge on the Windows PC.
- A 50-second promo video was requested in Sep 2026 (check status).

Related: [[Whisky Dashboard]], [[Whisky vs AI]]. Hub: [[Video and Content]].

text:
